fairUse.provenance: Rendered page 1 of the official publisher rules PDF https://www.arcanewonders.com/wp-content/uploads/2021/05/Onitama-Rulebook.pdf. The illustrated title page visibly identifies this game and matches the linked rules edition; reduced to 116 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: After dealing two Move cards to each player, reveal one more card. The player whose pawns match the colored stamp in that card’s lower-right corner goes first.
clarifications: Place the extra card to the starting player’s right.
